name: Tender Boiled Baby Red Beets (Peeled & Sliced)
whyItWorks: Fresh baby beets boiled until skin slips off effortlessly, then sliced into tender rounds. Soft texture rich in betalains and nitric oxide precursors; betalains harmlessly color stool red.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil whole trimmed beets in water for 45 minutes until tender. Rub skins off under cool water with a paper towel, slice thin, and season with olive oil and salt.
